en.headline: FEHD foreman charged with misconduct over bogus littering tickets
en.dek: The ICAC charged a 41-year-old Food and Environmental Hygiene Department officer with misconduct in public office after he allegedly issued five false fixed-penalty notices that led to court warrants and one wrongful…
body: A Food and Environmental Hygiene Department foreman has been charged with misconduct in public office for allegedly issuing five bogus fixed-penalty littering notices, the Independent Commission Against Corruption said on Tuesday.

Law Yui, 41, who was posted to the Sham Shui Po district Environmental Hygiene Office, is accused of issuing HK$3,000 notices to five people between December 2023 and February 2024 without reasonable excuse, even though no littering offences had occurred. The ICAC said the charge followed an internal FEHD investigation that referred the case to the graft-buster.

The five alleged victims had previously received notices from the same officer between 2021 and 2022. Unaware of the new notices, they did not pay the fines, resulting in court orders and arrest warrants. One person was arrested and appeared in court. Some of those named were not in Hong Kong at the time of the alleged offences. Law was released on bail and the case is scheduled for mention at West Kowloon Court on Thursday.

zh.headline: 食環署管工涉發虛假垃圾票 被廉政公署控公職人員行為失當
zh.dek: 一名41歲食環署管工被控向五人發出虛假定額罰款通知書，導致法庭發出拘捕令及一人被錯誤拘捕，案件由廉政公署跟進。
body: 廉政公署周二表示，一名食環署管工被控公職人員行為失當，涉嫌向五人發出虛假的定額罰款垃圾票。
41歲的羅銳（譯音）當時在深水埗區環境衛生辦事處任職，被指於2023年12月至2024年2月期間，在沒有合理辯解下向五人發出每張3,000元的定額罰款通知書，但實際上並無發生拋棄垃圾的罪行。廉署指，案件由食環署內部調查後轉介跟進。
五名事主早前曾於2021至2022年收到同一人員發出的通知書。由於不知悉新通知書，他們未有繳付罰款，其後被法庭頒令及發出拘捕令，其中一人更被拘捕及出庭。部分事主在指稱罪行發生時並不在香港。羅銳已獲准保釋，案件定於周四在西九龍裁判法院提訊。
